text:
megan: Heads-up: after rolling edge-proxy v1.9 we saw a ~12% uptick in project-less attributions in the quota dashboard. Looks like the new header-normalize feature rewrites incoming ApiKey fields and authz isn't picking them up.

devon: Which rewrite specifically?

megan: Proxy is changing `proj` -> `project_id` and collapsing `X-Project-Ref` -> `X-Project-Id`. Authz binder reads `proj_id` claim or token claim only. Some traffic still arrives with `proj` in the token binder and the rewrite removes the original key before authz sees it.

akira: Right. We basically have two schools: proxy-owns-canonicalization vs authz-owns-binding. Current rollout assumes proxy canonicalizes in-place. That breaks chains where sampler/cache run between proxy and authz.

sam: Telemetry: `quota.attribution_rate` dropped for a subset of customers using older SDKs that relied on `proj` header name. We also saw increased `auth.attribution_latency` due to extra fallbacks.

megan: UX: console shows "Project: unknown" with no hint. Support is getting noisy. Can we add a short diag card to the request detail: shows `observed_headers_before_rewrite` and `observed_headers_after_rewrite` so we can see if proxy rewrote keys?

tara: I can add a compact two-line diff view and a link to the playbook. Short text: "Header canonicalization observed. If project missing, verify proxy rewrite + sampler ordering."

akira: Quick technical mitigation: 1) make proxy feature opt-in via runtime flag `proxy.header_canonicalize=false` for canary nodes, 2) add compatibility acceptance in authz to accept both `proj` and `project_id` for 48h during rollout, and 3) emit `auth.proxy.rewrite_count` with tags `from:proj,to:project_id`.

devon: I'll flip the flag for infra-canary-6 to false and push the compat mapping to authz-staging. Also adding a unit/integration test that ensures header names survive sampler/cache/dedupe phases.

sam: I'll instrument two metrics: `auth.attribution.signal_loss` (increments when binder falls back to org-only) and `auth.attribution.fuzzy_match` (when compat mapping resolved project). That will let us track regressions.

ops-bot: deploy started: authz-compat-readers -> staging (requester=devon)

megan: Thanks. For the console badge, can we show the probable cause tags (e.g., "proxy-rewrite", "sampler-dropped", "cache-miss") so support can triage quickly?

tara: Yup. Badge options: green (ok), amber (fallback to org), red (missing project). I'll wire the tooltip to `auth.attribution.fallback_reason`.

akira: Long-term: RFC to define canonical header contract (names + precedence) and a CI lint that fails if router and authz header schemas diverge. Also recommend the binder prefer token claims over headers, headers over sampler-derived origins.

devon: Agreed. Plan: short canary rollback + compat mapping -> monitor 1hr -> gradual roll with flag ON for 10% traffic while metrics normalise.

megan: I'll create the tracker ticket and include the TSG diagnostic queries we used. Also adding a quick synthetic test template to the playbook: mixed SDK versions, SA tokens, user tokens.

sam: Pushed the metrics PR. Will post Grafana panel links when available.

megan: Good. Keep this thread as the rollout tracker. We'll reconvene after 1h of canary telemetry. :thumbsup:
